q_en:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Glut
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Glut
solution:
📌 Concept:
'Glut' का अर्थ है 'भरमार' या 'जरूरत से ज्यादा खाना'। इसका विलोम (Antonym) सीमित भोजन या संयम होगा।

🔍 Word Insight:
- Glut: Excess (अति)।
- Diet: संयमित भोजन।

🧠 Explanation (Option-wise Breakdown):
1. Swill → अत्यधिक मात्रा में पीना।
2. Diet → सही। यह कम या नियंत्रित मात्रा को दर्शाता है।
3. Guzzle → लालच से खाना/पीना।
4. Bolt → जल्दी से निगलना।

⚡ Smart Exam Trick:
बाकी तीन विकल्प (Swill, Guzzle, Bolt) 'अति' या 'तेजी' से जुड़े हैं, केवल 'Diet' अलग है।

q_en:
In the given sentence, the underlined segment is a proverb and it may have an error. Select the option that rectifies the given segment. If there is no error, select ‘No rectification required’.

After his first failed investment, Tom was much more cautious with his money; he had learned that once bitten, twice shy.
q_hi:
In the given sentence, the underlined segment is a proverb and it may have an error. Select the option that rectifies the given segment. If there is no error, select ‘No rectification required’.

After his first failed investment, Tom was much more cautious with his money; he had learned that once bitten, twice shy.
solution:
📌 Concept:
'Once bitten, twice shy' एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है। इसका अर्थ है: दूध का जला छाछ भी फूँक-फूँक कर पीता है।

🧠 Explanation:
वाक्य में मुहावरा बिल्कुल सही रूप में प्रयोग हुआ है। इसलिए किसी सुधार की जरूरत नहीं है।

q_en:
Select the option that rectifies the underlined incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The citizens showed great regilience during the crisis.
q_hi:
Select the option that rectifies the underlined incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The citizens showed great regilience during the crisis.
solution:
📌 Concept:
'Resilience' का अर्थ है विपरीत परिस्थितियों में भी हार न मानना (लचीलापन)।

🔍 Spelling Insight:
सही स्पेलिंग: R-E-S-I-L-I-E-N-C-E.

🧠 Explanation (Option-wise Breakdown):
यहाँ विकल्प 2 सही है। ध्यान दें कि इसमें 'c' से पहले 'e' आता है, 'a' नहीं।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her hasty decision to quit her job without a backup plan left her in a difficult situation.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her hasty decision to quit her job without a backup plan left her in a difficult situation.
solution:
📌 Concept:
'Hasty' का अर्थ है जल्दबाजी में किया गया (Done in a hurry).

🔍 Word Insight:
- Hasty: उतावल।
- Quick: तेज/जल्द।

🧠 Explanation (Option-wise Breakdown):
1. Heinous → जघन्य (बहुत बुरा अपराध)।
2. Deliberate → जान-बूझकर (उल्टा)।
3. Careful → सावधान (उल्टा)।
4. Quick → सही। जल्दबाजी के लिए सबसे करीब का शब्द।

q_en:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The roubust machine was designed to be durable as it was built with high quality materials and advanced technology.
q_hi:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The roubust machine was designed to be durable as it was built with high quality materials and advanced technology.
solution:
📌 Concept:
सही शब्द 'Robust' होता है, जिसका अर्थ है 'मजबूत'।

🧠 Explanation (Option-wise Breakdown):
1. technology → सही है।
2. roubust → गलत। सही स्पेलिंग Robust है। इसमें 'u' नहीं आता।
3. durable → टिकाऊ (सही है)।
4. designed → अभिकल्पित (सही है)。
